text: In February 2023 we spoke around one date. On February 7, sixty-six of us said "state of the union" and sixty-four said "state of the union address." The day before, February 6, twenty-eight said "the state of the union." We attached the president to it: thirty-seven said "biden's state of the union address," and thirty said "president biden's state of the union." Twenty of us said "the past two years." Sixteen said "state of the union address to," and sixteen said "for the american people." The counts cluster on February 7. Our record from this era is one event, said many times, in nearly the same words.
